class.name: FellowDestructible3D
class.brief_description: FellowEngine: an object that breaks — a crate, a pillar, a wall, a pane of glass — into rigid pieces along a Voronoi diagram, when hit hard enough, damaged to nothing, or told to.
class.description: A child of a body (a [StaticBody3D], [RigidBody3D] or [AnimatableBody3D]) whose [MeshInstance3D] it breaks: the body's own (its first [MeshInstance3D] child), or [member mesh_path]'s. When it breaks, the mesh is cut along the cells of a Voronoi diagram — [member piece_count] sites inside the solid, a share of them ([member impact_focus]) gathered around the point of impact, so the pieces are smaller there; a thin object (a pane, a plank) is cut across, never split in layers — on a worker thread, and each piece becomes a [RigidBody3D] with the mesh's materials on its outer faces, [member interior_material] on its cut faces (planar UVs, [member interior_uv_scale]), a mass from its volume and [member density], and a convex collision shape (a piece far from convex, a part of a wall bent round a window's corner, gets the hulls of its parts). The pieces start with the body's velocity, thrown out from the impact at up to [member burst_speed], and with the share of the impulse given to [method break_apart]; the body is freed ([member free_after_break]). What breaks it: [method break_apart]; [method damage] taking [member health] to zero; and with [member break_on_impact], a blow of [member break_impulse] N·s or more — for a [RigidBody3D] its change of velocity in a step (less gravity's) times its mass (a crate dropped, hit by a car; not one resting under a load), for a static body a rigid body striking it (its momentum towards it). The cut faces are the source's own cross-sections, holes and all, so the pieces are closed and their volumes add up to the source's; the source should be a closed mesh (an open one breaks into open pieces). A fracture on a worker thread appears a few frames after the blow (a 12-piece crate takes about 2 ms, a 4 000-triangle sphere in 32 pieces about 40 ms). With [member prefracture] the pattern is computed when the node is ready instead (on the main thread), and shared by every destructible of the same mesh, [member seed] and [member piece_count]: the break spawns its pieces at once. A frame spawns at most [method get_max_pieces_per_frame] pieces (a break over the budget waits for the next frame, intact). The pieces are debris: asleep past [member debris_lifetime] (or twice that old) they shrink away and are freed, and past [method get_max_debris] pieces in the game the oldest go first. See [code]docs/decisions/0182-destruction.md[/code].

method.name: break_apart
method.description: Breaks the object now (or, without [member prefracture], as soon as its fracture is computed on a worker thread): its pieces gathered around [param position] (global; the mesh's centre if zero) and pushed by [param impulse] (N·s, shared by the pieces near the position). Does nothing once broken.

method.name: clear_cache
method.description: Forgets the shared prefractured patterns (each is kept while a destructible uses it).

method.name: damage
method.description: Takes [param amount] from the health ([signal damaged]); at zero or less, breaks at [param position] with [param impulse] (see [method break_apart]).

method.name: get_current_health
method.description: The health left ([member health] at first).

method.name: get_debris_count
method.description: The pieces of every destructible still in the game.

method.name: get_global_stats
method.description: Every destructible's work since [method reset_global_stats]: [code]breaks[/code], [code]fractures[/code] (computed; a shared pattern counts once), [code]fracture_usec[/code] (worker threads, or the main thread when prefractured), [code]build_usec[/code] (the pieces' meshes and shapes, main thread), [code]spawn_usec[/code] (their nodes, main thread), [code]pieces[/code], [code]faded[/code] (debris shrunk away), [code]debris[/code] (now).

method.name: get_max_debris
method.description: The pieces the game keeps (256 by default): past it the oldest shrink away.

method.name: get_max_pieces_per_frame
method.description: The pieces a frame may spawn (128 by default; 0: no limit): a break over the budget waits for the next frame. The first break of a frame always spawns.

method.name: get_stats
method.description: This destructible's state: [code skip-lint]broken[/code], [code]pieces[/code], [code]fracture_usec[/code], [code]spawn_usec[/code], [code skip-lint]health[/code], [code]last_impact[/code] (N·s, the last blow it felt), [code]prefractured[/code].

method.name: is_broken
method.description: Whether it has broken (or is breaking: its fracture being computed).

method.name: reset_global_stats
method.description: Sets the counters of [method get_global_stats] to zero.

method.name: set_max_debris
method.description: Sets [method get_max_debris] for the whole game.

method.name: set_max_pieces_per_frame
method.description: Sets [method get_max_pieces_per_frame] for the whole game.

members.member: The body to remove when it breaks (its collision layers and mask go to the pieces). Empty: the parent, if a [CollisionObject3D], else the grandparent.
The blow, in N·s, that breaks it with [member break_on_impact] (a 1 kg stone at 40 m/s; a 40 kg crate falling 1 m gives about 180).
Breaks when a blow of [member break_impulse] or more strikes the body (a [RigidBody3D]'s contacts are monitored for it).
The speed, in m/s, at which the pieces nearest the impact are thrown out from it (less farther away).
Seconds a piece lives once asleep (twice this at most): then it shrinks away. 0: until the debris budget ([method get_max_debris]) takes it.
The pieces' density, in kg/m³ (wood 600, stone 2 500, glass 2 500): each piece's mass is its volume times this.
Frees the body (and this node) once the pieces are spawned; off, the mesh is hidden and the body's shapes disabled.
What [method damage] takes away; at zero it breaks.
The share of the pieces gathered around the point of impact, 0 to 1 (more: smaller pieces there, larger ones farther).
The cut faces' material (the mesh's first surface's when empty).
The cut faces' UVs: their position in the cut's plane, in metres, times this.
The [MeshInstance3D] to break. Empty: the parent, if one, else the parent's first [MeshInstance3D] child.
The pieces (the Voronoi diagram's sites; a cell that misses a concave mesh gives none, and one that holds parts that do not touch gives each).

Computes the pattern when the node is ready (on the main thread), shared by every destructible of the same mesh, [member seed] and [member piece_count]: the pieces spawn at once when it breaks, not gathered around the impact.

signal.name: broken
signal.description: Emitted when the pieces are spawned: [param pieces], their [RigidBody3D]s (each with a [MeshInstance3D] and [CollisionShape3D]s).

signal.name: damaged
signal.description: Emitted by [method damage]: the [param amount] taken and the [param health] left.
